title: Janeshwar Mishra Park, Lucknow - Asia’s Largest Urban Park
content:
Janeshwar Mishra Park, Lucknow

Janeshwar Mishra Park is one of the most beautiful and expansive green spaces in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Located in Gomti Nagar, this park is often called Asia’s largest urban park and is inspired by London’s Hyde Park. With lush gardens, lakes, jogging tracks, and open spaces, it offers a perfect escape into nature right in the heart of the city.

Spread across hundreds of acres, the park is a favorite spot for morning walkers, fitness lovers, families, and tourists seeking peace and fresh air.

History & Vision

The park is named after Janeshwar Mishra, a respected socialist leader from Uttar Pradesh. It was developed to provide Lucknow with a large eco-friendly green zone that supports biodiversity and offers citizens a space for recreation, fitness, and relaxation.

The vision behind the park was to create a sustainable urban forest that also helps in improving the city’s environment.

Attractions Inside the Park

Janeshwar Mishra Park has something for visitors of all ages:

  • Large Water Bodies & Lakes - adding scenic beauty
  • Jogging & Walking Tracks - well-paved paths for fitness
  • Cycling Tracks - for cycling enthusiasts
  • Children’s Play Areas - safe and fun zones
  • Open Lawns & Gardens - perfect for picnics
  • Bridges & Viewpoints - for photography
  • Yoga & Meditation Areas - calm spaces for wellness

The park is also home to many birds and plants, making it ideal for nature lovers.

Park in the Morning & Evening

  • Morning: Fresh air, peaceful walks, yoga groups, and joggers
  • Evening: Families, kids, and friends enjoying sunsets and cool breeze
  • Both times offer different but equally pleasant experiences.

Location & How to Reach

Janeshwar Mishra Park is located in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow.

  • By Road: Easily reachable by auto, cab, and city buses
  • Nearest Metro: Indira Nagar / Gomti Nagar region stations
  • From Charbagh Railway Station: 9-10 km
  • From Airport: 18-20 km

Timings & Entry Fee

  • Timings: Early morning to evening (commonly around 5:00 AM - 9:00 PM)
  • Entry Fee: Usually free or nominal

(Timings may change as per local rules.)

Best Time to Visit

  • October to March: Best season for outdoor activities
  • Morning & evening: Most pleasant times
  • Avoid afternoons during peak summer.

Nearby Places to Visit

  • Ambedkar Memorial Park
  • Gomti Riverfront
  • Hazratganj Market 
  • Indira Dam
  • Gomti Nagar local markets & cafés
